title: 雪是怎么来的
subtitle: 每一片都不一样
character: wearing a red padded coat, dark blue trousers and brown boots, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration made of cut paper layers in white, ice blue and soft grey on a deep blue paper background, clean crisp edges with small paper shadows, flat and simple

pages.zh:
早上拉开窗帘，
外面白茫茫的一片。
下雪了！
我伸出手，
接住了一片小小的雪花。
pages.scene: The little boy in a red padded coat stands at a window with one hand held out, catching a snowflake, snow falling outside.

pages.zh:
雪是从云里来的。
云不是棉花，
它是许许多多
看不见的小水珠和小冰晶，
挤在一起变成的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one large white cloud shape on a deep blue background, with a magnified circle beside it showing many tiny round droplets and small ice crystals inside the cloud. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
天很冷的时候，
水汽不会先变成水珠，
而是直接冻在一粒灰尘上，
变成一颗小小的冰晶。
这就是雪花的种子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one tiny dust speck in the middle of a deep blue background with a small six-sided ice crystal forming around it, shown large. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
冰晶在云里飘来飘去，
水汽不停地冻到它身上。
它慢慢长大，
长出六个角——
雪花都有六个角。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one six-armed snowflake shown large in the middle of a deep blue background, each arm the same length and shape as the others. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
为什么是六个角呢？
因为水结冰的时候，
小水分子总是排成六边形。
从第一颗冰晶开始，
它就照这个规矩长。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one flat six-sided hexagon outline in the middle of a deep blue background with small round dots evenly placed at each corner. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雪花长什么样，
要看它走过的路。
又冷又湿的地方，
它长出很多花枝；
干一点的地方，长成小板子。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two snowflakes side by side on a deep blue background, the left one with many fine branching arms, the right one a plain flat six-sided plate. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
每一片雪花，
走的路都不完全一样，
所以长得也不一样。
人们说，
世界上找不到两片相同的雪花。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: six different white snowflakes arranged evenly on a deep blue background, each with a clearly different arm pattern, all the same size. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雪花变重了，
就从云里飘下来。
它很轻，落得很慢，
一路打着转，
像坐着滑梯下来。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: three snowflakes falling on a deep blue background with thin curved dotted lines behind them showing their slow spiralling path. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
落到地上以后，
雪花们叠在一起，
中间留着好多小空隙。
空隙里藏着空气，
所以雪看起来蓬蓬松松的。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: a cross-section of a snow layer on a deep blue background, made of many overlapping white flakes with small dark gaps of air between them. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
雪盖在地上，
像给麦苗盖了一床被子。
被子里的空气不容易散热，
下面的土反而暖和，
小苗就冻不坏了。
pages.scene: A cross-section on a deep blue background: a thick white snow layer lying over brown soil, with small green seedlings standing in the soil under the snow. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
天一暖，
雪就化成水，
渗进土里，流进小河。
春天的水，
有一半是冬天存下的雪。
pages.scene: A simple scene on a deep blue background: a patch of melting white snow at the top with water trickling down into brown soil and into a small stream. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我在院子里堆了一个雪人，
给它插了一根胡萝卜鼻子。
爸爸说，天晴了它就会化。
没关系——
它会变成水，明年再变成雪。
pages.scene: The little boy in a red padded coat stands beside a snowman he has built in a snowy yard, patting its head, a carrot nose on the snowman.
